notes.title: (Hopefully) Release patch notes!
notes.content:
Fixed how difficult it was to remove smoke once you get smokey'd

Added a few tooltips to explain when important things are happening (like waving mouse for smokey, and when you're running low on time!)

Tuned the grab logic to be more consistent and less 'slippery'

Added matches!

Matches now detonate bombs if they touch, sending things flying, adding to the chaos! (Sorry!)

Added retry logic for the requester if the pack no longer contains the requested item (such as item falling, voiding, exploding)

notes.title: Patch notes? How formal!
notes.content:
Fixed steam achievements 

Removed unnecessary logging 

added node or null checks to fix other logs 

changed time left mechanic to actually matter at all 

Timer highlights red when low 

put timer reset into it's own function that now also runs when enchanting so you don't lose time on the next request 

Lowered threshold for maid adding new items so you're less likely to get swamped 

Made her throw 3 things instead of 5 when adding new stuff to bag

Also made it so the game actually ends if the timer runs out (lmao)

Also made it so the game won't end multiple times when the conditions for ending the game are met
